text:
maria (docs): quick heads-up — opening a PR to overhaul the offline install guide for private deploys. main goals: add a small-package-mirror howto, explicit GPG key rotation steps for mirrored repos, and a clearer HSM connector troubleshooting section. want eyes on the HSM mount/permissions bits.

devon (infra): @maria (docs) thanks — tagging. i can validate the mirror commands and the firewall port table. do you have a sample mirror script? :eyes:

maria (docs): adding initial script in the PR description. example below for apt-mirror (simple):
```bash
# on mirror host
apt-mirror --config /etc/apt/mirror.list
rsync -av --delete /var/spool/apt-mirror/mirror/ ubuntu-mirror:/srv/apt/
# serve via nginx with basic auth
```

sre-jen: for yum/rpm folks we should include createrepo_c + reposync snippet. also note SELinux context for /srv/repos if serving HTTP.

alex (sdk): i will add a short SDK snippet showing how to override the default package URL to point at an internal mirror — two lines for python sdk config and a note about TLS cert pinning.

maria (docs): perfect. @sre-jen can you paste the selinux chcon commands you recommend?

sre-jen: sure — `chcon -R -t httpd_sys_content_t /srv/repos` and `restorecon -Rv /srv/repos` — add a note to run as root. also call out `firewall-cmd --add-service=http --permanent && firewall-cmd --reload`.

devon (infra): on the GPG side, we need a clear flow: generate key on an airgapped host, export public key, import to mirror server, sign packages during mirror creation. suggest this snippet: 
```bash
# on offline host
gpg --full-generate-key
gpg --export --armor mirror-key.pub > mirror-key.pub
# on mirror server
gpg --import mirror-key.pub
```

maria (docs): adding a short 'rotate GPG key' subsection too. also want to clarify HSM connector permissions — in the current doc the socket path is ambiguous. @devon any recommended locations?

devon (infra): we standardize on /var/run/redwood-hsm/priv. require chown hsm:root and 0700 for the dir. note that systemd unit must reference that path and we recommend a tmpfiles.d entry: `/etc/tmpfiles.d/redwood-hsm.conf` with `d /var/run/redwood-hsm 0700 hsm root - -`.

maria (docs): adding that. also adding a troubleshooting bulleted list: common failure is 'permission denied' from plugin, remind users to check group membership and PAM limits.

docs-bot: preview deployed: https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/offline-install/2387654321 — PR #4572

alex (sdk): PR looks good to me aside from one link that 404s (old pkcs11 page). i'll paste the new link in a follow-up commit.

maria (docs): thanks. assigning reviewers: @devon (infra), @sre-jen, @alex (sdk). i'm also going to include a tiny migration checklist for customers migrating from 'online' to 'mirror' mode (steps: snapshot local keys, mirror packages, switch apt sources, restart services in maintenance window).

devon (infra): can you also add a one-line rollback command for apt in case the mirror misbehaves? e.g., `cp /etc/apt/sources.list.d/orig.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/`.

maria (docs): will do. final ask: if reviewers can mark :thumbsup: on the PR or leave quick comments today, i'd like to merge by EOD to include in next release notes.

sre-jen: :thumbsup: will check SELinux + rpm snippets.

alex (sdk): :thumbsup: updating the SDK snippet link now.

devon (infra): :eyes: reviewing mirrors + GPG flows, will ping if anything blocks.

deploy-bot: doc-commit CI passed — preview updated at https://docs-preview.internal/redwood/offline-install/PR-4572/preview.html

maria (docs): awesome, thanks all — i'll push the follow-ups shortly and merge once comments are addressed.
